create_Hermes2ProToolParser: create a Hermes2ProToolParser instance with a tokenizer to parse tool calls from Hermes model output
extract_tool_calls: extract tool calls from a model output string containing delimited JSON regions
extract_tool_calls_streaming: stream tool call deltas incrementally from accumulated model output during generation
adjust_request: adjust a chat completion request to disable special token skipping for Hermes tool calling
extract_tool_call_jsons: extract tool call JSON fragments from text, detecting complete and partial regions
